title: Variance bound for Boolean functions
statement: Let $P$ be a finite product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on its product outcome space taking values in $\{-1,1\}$. Then $\operatorname{Var}_P(f)\leq 1$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a product of finite probability spaces
each coordinate atom has strictly positive mass
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$ and $f:\Omega\to\{-1,1\}$. Then $\operatorname{Var}_P(f)\le1$.
